desc:
Stay covered and comfortable with this Flecktarn neck gaiter, built for practical use. Made from a soft, stretchy, moisture-wicking fabric, this tubular gaiter pulls on easily and adapts to multiple styles — worn as a neck warmer, face cover, headband, or light balaclava. The classic German Flecktarn camouflage pattern provides effective low-visibility coverage while remaining versatile across seasons.

Small Agarthan Armory logo on back.
